# Cenikor Foundation

> > Cenikor Foundation provides CARF-accredited substance abuse treatment and behavioral health services across Texas, offering MAT, IOP, dual diagnosis care, and recovery housing programs.

Founded by Bill Bailey, Cenikor operates evidence-based addiction treatment centers throughout Texas including Corpus Christi, Houston, Tyler, Fort Worth, Waco, and Amarillo. The organization provides a full continuum of care from medical detox through residential treatment, outpatient services, and recovery support, serving adults, adolescents, and families with HIPAA-compliant, integrated behavioral health services.

## Key Topics

- Medication-Assisted Treatment (MAT)
- Intensive Outpatient Program (IOP)
- Dual Diagnosis Treatment
- CARF Accreditation
- Relapse Prevention
- Adolescent Recovery Programs
- Family Therapy
- Recovery Housing & Sober Living
- Medical Detox Services
- Substance Use Disorder (SUD)
- Behavioral Health Integration
- 12-Step Programs
- Continuum of Care
- Texas Treatment Locations
- Peer Recovery Support Services

## Treatment Programs & Services

- [Medication Assisted Treatment (MAT) Corpus Christi](https://www.cenikor.org/resources/medication-assisted-treatment-mat-corpus-christi): Corpus Christi MAT combining FDA-approved medications with counseling
- [Adolescent Recovery Program](https://www.cenikor.org/resources/adolescent-recovery-program): Teen addiction recovery program with family support and therapy services
- [Dual Diagnosis Treatment Tyler](https://www.cenikor.org/resources/dual-diagnosis-treatment-tyler): Tyler location dual diagnosis care for co-occurring mental health disorders
- [Dual Diagnosis Treatment Amarillo](https://www.cenikor.org/resources/dual-diagnosis-treatment-amarillo): Amarillo integrated care for substance abuse and mental health disorders
- [Medical Detox Corpus Christi](https://www.cenikor.org/resources/medical-detox-corpus-christi): Corpus Christi medical detox services for safe withdrawal management
- [Tyler IOP Tailors Recovery to Your Schedule](https://www.cenikor.org/resources/intensive-outpatient-program-tyler): Tyler Intensive Outpatient Program offering flexible addiction treatment
- [Recovery Housing in Houston: A Bridge to Independence](https://www.cenikor.org/resources/recovery-housing-houston): Houston sober living and recovery housing with IOP and MAT support
- [Family Therapy Corpus Christi](https://www.cenikor.org/resources/family-therapy-corpus-christi): Corpus Christi family therapy with 12-step and Al-Anon support programs

## Recovery Resources & Education

- [How to Stay Sober After Rehab: Building a Support System](https://www.cenikor.org/resources/how-to-stay-sober-after-rehab-building-a-support-system): Post-rehab sobriety guide covering support systems and relapse prevention
- [Ways To Stay Sober During The Holidays](https://www.cenikor.org/resources/ways-to-stay-sober-during-the-holidays): Holiday sobriety tips using CBT and DBT relapse prevention strategies
- [7 Signs of Prescription Drug Misuse](https://www.cenikor.org/resources/7-signs-of-prescription-drug-misuse): Warning signs guide for identifying prescription drug misuse and dependency
- [Treating Substance Use Disorder at Home](https://www.cenikor.org/resources/treating-substance-use-disorder-at-home-a-growing-need-amid-stress-and-uncertainty): Home-based SUD treatment options including telehealth and coping strategies
- [Teens and Addiction: How to Help Your Child Avoid Drugs and Alcohol](https://www.cenikor.org/resources/back-to-school-a-guide-to-avoiding-drugs-and-alcohol): Parent guide for teen substance abuse prevention and drug education
- [How to Talk to Your Parents About Addiction](https://www.cenikor.org/resources/talking-to-parents-about-addiction): Teen guide for discussing addiction concerns with parents effectively
